SELECT '🏅 Hypermiler' AS "Achievement",
       'Drive >' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '30 mi' ELSE '50 km' END || ' with >100% efficiency vs rated range' AS "Mission",
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id 
    AND convert_km(distance::numeric, '$length_unit') > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 30 ELSE 50 END)
    AND (start_rated_range_km - end_rated_range_km) > 0
    AND distance > (start_rated_range_km - end_rated_range_km)
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Status"

UNION ALL

SELECT '⚡ Supercharger Junkie', 'Fast charge at speeds over 120 kW',
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM charges c JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.id = c.charging_process_id
    WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND c.charger_power > 120
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '⚠️ Living on the Edge', 'Finish a drive with less than 5% battery',
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM drives d JOIN positions p ON p.id = d.end_position_id
    WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND p.battery_level < 5
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🍃 Efficiency Master', 'Efficiency >100% vs Rated (7-day streak)',
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM (
        SELECT avg(distance / NULLIF(start_rated_range_km - end_rated_range_km, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY start_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as eff
        FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id AND convert_km(distance::numeric, '$length_unit') > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 6 ELSE 10 END)
    ) sub WHERE eff >= 1.0
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🌿 Efficiency Expert', 'Efficiency >110% vs Rated (7-day streak)',
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM (
        SELECT avg(distance / NULLIF(start_rated_range_km - end_rated_range_km, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY start_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as eff
        FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id AND convert_km(distance::numeric, '$length_unit') > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 6 ELSE 10 END)
    ) sub WHERE eff >= 1.1
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🧘 Efficiency Guru', 'Efficiency >120% vs Rated (7-day streak)',
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM (
        SELECT avg(distance / NULLIF(start_rated_range_km - end_rated_range_km, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY start_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as eff
        FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id AND convert_km(distance::numeric, '$length_unit') > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 6 ELSE 10 END)
    ) sub WHERE eff >= 1.2
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

SELECT '🏙️ Local Explorer' AS "Achievement", 'Visit 5 different cities' AS "Mission",
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT count(distinct city) FROM addresses a JOIN drives d ON d.end_address_id = a.id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id
) >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Status"

UNION ALL

SELECT '🗺️ Regional Explorer', 'Visit 10 different regions/counties',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT count(distinct county) FROM addresses a JOIN drives d ON d.end_address_id = a.id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id
) >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🇪🇸 National Explorer', 'Visit 15 different States/Provinces',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT count(distinct state) FROM addresses a JOIN drives d ON d.end_address_id = a.id WHERE d.car_id = $car_id
) >= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🎒 Adventurer',
       'Travel more than ' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '185 mi' ELSE '300 km' END || ' from home',
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM positions p, geofences g
    WHERE p.car_id = $car_id AND (g.name ILIKE '%Home%' OR g.name ILIKE '%Casa%')
    AND convert_km(
        (6371 * acos(LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0, cos(radians(g.latitude)) * cos(radians(p.latitude)) * cos(radians(p.longitude) - radians(g.longitude)) + sin(radians(g.latitude)) * sin(radians(p.latitude))))))::numeric,
        '$length_unit'
    ) > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 185 ELSE 300 END)
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🌍 Globetrotter',
       'Travel more than ' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '310 mi' ELSE '500 km' END || ' from home',
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM positions p, geofences g
    WHERE p.car_id = $car_id AND (g.name ILIKE '%Home%' OR g.name ILIKE '%Casa%')
    AND convert_km(
        (6371 * acos(LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(-1.0, cos(radians(g.latitude)) * cos(radians(p.latitude)) * cos(radians(p.longitude) - radians(g.longitude)) + sin(radians(g.latitude)) * sin(radians(p.latitude))))))::numeric,
        '$length_unit'
    ) > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 310 ELSE 500 END)
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

SELECT '❄️ Sub-Zero' AS "Achievement",
       'Charge while outside temp is below ' || CASE WHEN '$temp_unit' = 'F' THEN '32°F' ELSE '0°C' END AS "Mission",
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM charging_processes cp JOIN positions p ON p.id = cp.position_id
    WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND p.outside_temp < 0
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Status"

UNION ALL

SELECT '🦇 Night Rider', 'Complete a drive between 02:00 AM and 05:00 AM',
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', start_date))) BETWEEN 2 AND 4
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🌙 Night Owl',
       'Accumulate >' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '60 mi' ELSE '100 km' END || ' at night (00:00-06:00)',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT convert_km(sum(distance)::numeric, '$length_unit') FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', start_date))) BETWEEN 0 AND 5
) > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 60 ELSE 100 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🦉 Midnight Warrior',
       'Accumulate >' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '300 mi' ELSE '500 km' END || ' at night (00:00-06:00)',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT convert_km(sum(distance)::numeric, '$length_unit') FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', start_date))) BETWEEN 0 AND 5
) > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 300 ELSE 500 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🌅 Early Bird', 'Start 10 charging sessions before 7:00 AM',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT count(*) FROM charging_processes WHERE car_id = $car_id AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', start_date))) < 7
) >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🐓 Rise and Shine', 'Start 50 charging sessions before 7:00 AM',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT count(*) FROM charging_processes WHERE car_id = $car_id AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', start_date))) < 7
) >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '📅 Veteran', 'Data collected for more than 1 year',
CASE WHEN (NOW() - (SELECT min(start_date) FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id)) > INTERVAL '1 year'
THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

SELECT '🍑 Iron Butt' AS "Achievement",
       'Drive >' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '250 mi' ELSE '400 km' END || ' in a single trip' AS "Mission",
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT convert_km(max(distance)::numeric, '$length_unit') FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 250 ELSE 400 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Status"

UNION ALL

SELECT '🏃 Total Marathoner',
       'Accumulate >' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '6,200 mi' ELSE '10,000 km' END || ' total distance',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT convert_km(sum(distance)::numeric, '$length_unit') FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 6200 ELSE 10000 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '👟 Daily Marathoner',
       'Drive >' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '310 mi' ELSE '500 km' END || ' in a single day',
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id GROUP BY timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', start_date))::date 
    HAVING convert_km(sum(distance)::numeric, '$length_unit') > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 310 ELSE 500 END)
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🦾 Ultra Marathoner',
       'Drive >' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '500 mi' ELSE '800 km' END || ' in a single day',
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id GROUP BY timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', start_date))::date 
    HAVING convert_km(sum(distance)::numeric, '$length_unit') > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 500 ELSE 800 END)
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🚀 Speedster',
       'Reach a top speed >' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '110 mph' ELSE '180 km/h' END,
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM positions WHERE car_id = $car_id 
    AND convert_km(speed::numeric, '$length_unit') > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 110 ELSE 180 END)
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🧘 Smooth Operator',
       CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '600 mi' ELSE '1,000 km' END || ' streak without exceeding ' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '75 mph' ELSE '120 km/h' END,
CASE WHEN (
    WITH LastSpeedingEvent AS (
        SELECT max(date) as last_speeding_time
        FROM positions
        WHERE car_id = $car_id 
          AND convert_km(speed::numeric, '$length_unit') > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 75 ELSE 120 END)
    )
    SELECT convert_km(sum(distance)::numeric, '$length_unit')
    FROM drives
    WHERE car_id = $car_id
    AND start_date > COALESCE((SELECT last_speeding_time FROM LastSpeedingEvent), '2000-01-01')
) > (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 600 ELSE 1000 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

SELECT '🔓 First Spark' AS "Achievement", 'First time data recorded' AS "Mission",
CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Status"

UNION ALL

SELECT '🆓 Bounty Hunter', 'Charge 100 kWh for free (0 cost recorded)',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(charge_energy_added) FROM charging_processes 
    WHERE car_id = $car_id AND (cost = 0 OR cost IS NULL)
) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🏴‍☠️ Freeloader', 'Charge 1,000 kWh for free',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(charge_energy_added) FROM charging_processes 
    WHERE car_id = $car_id AND (cost = 0 OR cost IS NULL)
) >= 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🌙 Night Planner', 'Complete 50 charging sessions off-peak (00:00-08:00)',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT count(*) FROM charging_processes 
    WHERE car_id = $car_id AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', start_date))) BETWEEN 0 AND 8
) >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🐖 Thrifty', 'Save estimated >500€ vs Gas',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT (sum(distance)*0.10) - (SELECT sum(coalesce(cost,0)) FROM charging_processes WHERE car_id = $car_id)
    FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) > 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🤑 Green Tycoon', 'Save estimated >1,000€ vs Gas',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT (sum(distance)*0.10) - (SELECT sum(coalesce(cost,0)) FROM charging_processes WHERE car_id = $car_id)
    FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

SELECT '🧘 Patient Lvl 1' AS "Achievement", 'Spent 10 hours charging total' AS "Mission",
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(duration_min) FROM charging_processes WHERE car_id = $car_id
) >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Status"

UNION ALL

SELECT '🧘 Patient Lvl 2', 'Spent 50 hours charging total',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(duration_min) FROM charging_processes WHERE car_id = $car_id
) >= 3000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🧘 Patient Lvl 3', 'Spent 100 hours charging total',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(duration_min) FROM charging_processes WHERE car_id = $car_id
) >= 6000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🔌 AC Devotee', '80% of charging sessions are AC (Slow)',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT 
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE (charge_energy_added / NULLIF(duration_min/60.0, 0)) < 22)::float 
        / NULLIF(count(*)::float, 0)
    FROM charging_processes WHERE car_id = $car_id AND duration_min > 0
) >= 0.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '⚡ Fast Charge Pro', 'Complete 100 Supercharger sessions (>50kW)',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT count(*) 
    FROM charging_processes 
    WHERE car_id = $car_id 
    AND duration_min > 0
    AND (charge_energy_added / NULLIF(duration_min/60.0, 0)) > 50
) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🔋 Full Cycle', 'Charge from <10% to >95%',
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM charging_processes 
    WHERE car_id = $car_id 
    AND start_battery_level < 10 
    AND end_battery_level > 95
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '📐 The Optimizer', 'Finish 100 charges between 80-90% SoC',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT count(*) FROM charging_processes 
    WHERE car_id = $car_id AND end_battery_level BETWEEN 80 AND 90
) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

SELECT '🛡️ Planet Guardian' AS "Achievement", 'Save 1,000 kg of CO2 vs ICE car' AS "Mission",
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(distance) * 0.12 FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) >= 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Status"

UNION ALL

SELECT '🦸 Climate Hero', 'Save 5,000 kg of CO2 vs ICE car',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(distance) * 0.12 FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) >= 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🌳 Personal Forest', 'Save CO2 equivalent to planting 50 trees',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(distance) * 0.12 FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) >= (50 * 22) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🦜 Amazon Rainforest', 'Save CO2 equivalent to planting 200 trees',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(distance) * 0.12 FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) >= (200 * 22) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

SELECT '🌍 Around the World' AS "Achievement",
       'Drive ' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '24,901 mi' ELSE '40,075 km' END || ' (Earth Circumference)' AS "Mission",
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT convert_km(sum(distance)::numeric, '$length_unit') FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) >= (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 24901 ELSE 40075 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Status"

UNION ALL

SELECT '🛰️ ISS Orbiter',
       'Drive ' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '26,400 mi' ELSE '42,500 km' END || ' (One ISS Orbit distance)',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT convert_km(sum(distance)::numeric, '$length_unit') FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) >= (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 26400 ELSE 42500 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🚀 To the Moon',
       'Drive ' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '238,855 mi' ELSE '384,400 km' END || ' (Earth to Moon distance)',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT convert_km(sum(distance)::numeric, '$length_unit') FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) >= (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 238855 ELSE 384400 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🏎️ 24h Le Mans', 'Spend 24 total hours driving',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(duration_min) FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) >= (24 * 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '📸 Road Tourist', 'Spend 100 total hours driving',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(duration_min) FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) >= (100 * 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '📅 A Week on the Road', 'Spend 168 total hours (1 week) driving',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(duration_min) FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) >= (168 * 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

SELECT '🔥 Daily Driver (7 Days)' AS "Achievement", 'Drive 7 consecutive days' AS "Mission",
CASE WHEN (
    WITH Dates AS (SELECT DISTINCT timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', start_date))::date as d FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id),
    Groups AS (SELECT d, d - (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d) * interval '1 day') as grp FROM Dates),
    Streaks AS (SELECT count(*) as days FROM Groups GROUP BY grp)
    SELECT max(days) FROM Streaks
) >= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Status"

UNION ALL

SELECT '🔥 Daily Driver (30 Days)', 'Drive 30 consecutive days',
CASE WHEN (
    WITH Dates AS (SELECT DISTINCT timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', start_date))::date as d FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id),
    Groups AS (SELECT d, d - (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d) * interval '1 day') as grp FROM Dates),
    Streaks AS (SELECT count(*) as days FROM Groups GROUP BY grp)
    SELECT max(days) FROM Streaks
) >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🔥 Daily Driver (100 Days)', 'Drive 100 consecutive days',
CASE WHEN (
    WITH Dates AS (SELECT DISTINCT timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', start_date))::date as d FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id),
    Groups AS (SELECT d, d - (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY d) * interval '1 day') as grp FROM Dates),
    Streaks AS (SELECT count(*) as days FROM Groups GROUP BY grp)
    SELECT max(days) FROM Streaks
) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🏖️ Weekender', '60% of driving done on weekends',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(distance) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', start_date))) IN (6,7)) 
           / NULLIF(sum(distance), 0)
    FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '💼 Workaholic', '60% of driving done on weekdays (Mon-Fri)',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(distance) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM timezone('$__timezone', timezone('UTC', start_date))) NOT IN (6,7)) 
           / NULLIF(sum(distance), 0)
    FROM drives WHERE car_id = $car_id
) > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🔥 Inferno Rider',
       'Drive in temperatures > ' || CASE WHEN '$temp_unit' = 'F' THEN '104°F' ELSE '40°C' END,
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM positions WHERE car_id = $car_id AND outside_temp > 40
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '❄️ Ice Road Trucker',
       'Drive in temperatures < ' || CASE WHEN '$temp_unit' = 'F' THEN '14°F' ELSE '-10°C' END,
CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM positions WHERE car_id = $car_id AND outside_temp < -10
) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '⛰️ Mountaineer',
       'Climb ' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '32,800 ft' ELSE '10,000 m' END || ' cumulative elevation',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(convert_m((p_end.elevation - p_start.elevation)::numeric, CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 'ft' ELSE 'm' END))
    FROM drives d
    JOIN positions p_start ON d.start_position_id = p_start.id
    JOIN positions p_end ON d.end_position_id = p_end.id
    WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND p_end.elevation > p_start.elevation
) >= (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 32800 ELSE 10000 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🧗 Alpinist',
       'Climb ' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '164,000 ft' ELSE '50,000 m' END || ' cumulative elevation',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(convert_m((p_end.elevation - p_start.elevation)::numeric, CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 'ft' ELSE 'm' END))
    FROM drives d
    JOIN positions p_start ON d.start_position_id = p_start.id
    JOIN positions p_end ON d.end_position_id = p_end.id
    WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND p_end.elevation > p_start.elevation
) >= (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 164000 ELSE 50000 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

UNION ALL

SELECT '🏔️ The Sherpa',
       'Climb ' || CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN '328,000 ft' ELSE '100,000 m' END || ' cumulative elevation',
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT sum(convert_m((p_end.elevation - p_start.elevation)::numeric, CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 'ft' ELSE 'm' END))
    FROM drives d
    JOIN positions p_start ON d.start_position_id = p_start.id
    JOIN positions p_end ON d.end_position_id = p_end.id
    WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND p_end.elevation > p_start.elevation
) >= (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 328000 ELSE 100000 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
